reply_text:
I saved Tobias's Wednesday 11:30 call with the Tansley Parcel team for the Marlowe rollout to memory, and replied in the DM to confirm. The note is linked to the existing note about their Friday 8:30 Marrow Fieldworks call. Both notes are marked to be used only when answering Tobias, since they came from a private DM. Tobias didn't give a timezone, so the note just records that the message was sent at UTC-5.

I also made a small wording change to the older Marrow note so it refers to Tobias as "they" instead of "he."
